newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T declines comment on tobacco talks.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T declines comment on tobacco talks.

text.p: A spokesman for B.A.T Industries Plc declined to comment on Thursday over speculation a settlement between the U.S. tobacco industry and state attorneys general could be reached next week.
Overnight a source close to the talks told Reuters in Washington that state attorneys general expected to reach an agreement with cigarette companies next week.
Brown & Williamson, a unit of B.A.T Industries and America's third largest cigarette maker, is involved in the industry wide talks.
The state officers along with plaintiffs lawyers in class action cases and members of the health community, have been negotiating with the industry since early April.
At least 36 state attorneys general have sued the industry to recoup Medicaid costs of smokers.
B.A.T shares were 3p lower at 571 in early trade.
